scope: Organizational names only. Neither assay equivalence nor historical ancestry follows from folder membership.

name_bindings.name: Repli-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Spacing/hyphen variation in the printed DNA poster label; preserve separate source depictions and do not assert implementation equivalence.

name_bindings.name: ChIRP-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Poster cites Chu 2011 Mol Cell 44:667–678; website ChIRP-Seq lists the corresponding PMID 21963238. Preserve both literal labels.

name_bindings.name: CLASH-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Poster cites Kudla 2011 PNAS 108; website CLASH-Seq lists PMID 21610164. This is source organization, not a claim that every later CLASH implementation is identical.

name_bindings.name: IN-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Poster Goodman 2009 Cell Host Microbe 6:279–289 corresponds to card PMID 19748469; do not merge the separately named Tn-Seq method.

name_bindings.name: CAGE-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Both sources cite Takahashi 2012 Nat Protoc 7:542–561.

name_bindings.name: UMI
name_bindings.reason: Both sources cite Kivioja 2012 Nat Methods 9:72–74; collect the named technique without claiming that UMI is a whole assay.

name_bindings.name: ddRADSeq
name_bindings.reason: Double-digest RAD name spelling. Grouped RAD source remains shared, not evidence that RAD and ddRAD are identical.

name_bindings.name: DNase-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Website typography uses lowercase l where DNase I is intended; grouped source and Boyle reference retained.

name_bindings.name: DNase-Seq
name_bindings.reason: Alternative name in the same DNase I hypersensitivity poster row; retain implementation references separately.

name_bindings.name: Paired-end RAD-Seq
name_bindings.reason: PE expands paired-end; shared RAD row remains source-scoped.

name_bindings.name: TCR Chain Pairing
name_bindings.reason: Poster label spelling; organizational correction only, not identity of every TCR pairing implementation.
